# WG20 · Xuất CSV · lỗi

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **built (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#bind`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `finance.js › bind()` `#export` catch: a non-OK response throws `Error('Không xuất được bảng')` and the message is written to `#error` (`<div id="error" role="alert">` under the tabs); a network failure shows the browser own text instead (for example "Failed to fetch").
- The reach answers `/export*` with HTTP 500 (route `status`), then clicks "Xuất CSV cho Excel".
- Inventory note: Export answers with an HTTP error: the red #error line reads "Không xuất được bảng" (a network failure shows the browser own text, for example "Failed to fetch").
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"work\"]"} → {"wait":"#export"} → {"status":["http://127.0.0.1:4174/export*",500]} → {"click":"#export"}; it must show "Không xuất được bảng".

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Không xuất được bảng

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Không xuất được bảng"
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".
- Mock and backend (U6): money is whole VND, shares and rates are basis points; commission `(base * rate + 5000) // 10000`; the revenue of a procedure is split by share with the remainder on the last performer; a closed month reads its frozen rows and refuses new entries, Duyệt, Hủy and a second close; blockers in order "Chỉ chốt tháng đã kết thúc", "Kỳ không có dữ liệu", "Còn lượt tính theo thực thu chưa thu đủ; chưa thể chốt để tránh mất tiền kỳ sau", "Còn lượt chờ duyệt"; a receipt carries an idempotency key (same key and content returns the first receipt, other content is "Mã giao dịch đã dùng cho nội dung khác"; over the balance is "Số thu vượt công nợ").

## Differences from the app design
- Next.js (U6): the four tabs of `finance.js` are routes (`/finance`, `/finance/entries`, `/finance/rates`, `/finance/payments`) under one shell with the month picker "Kỳ báo cáo" in `?month=` and "Làm mới"; two screens have no old page: `/finance/periods` ("Chốt kỳ": 12 months, why a month cannot close, "Chốt tháng", "Xác nhận đã chi") and `/finance/export` ("Tải CSV cho Excel"). Both are Next.js-only (D3).
- Next.js (U6): there is no role/doctor picker; the projection comes from the signed-in session (`finance.read` clinic, `finance.read_own` personal). The owner flips "Toàn phòng khám" and "Cá nhân" with `?scope=own`; a doctor never sees the clinic scope. The hero line of the owner reads "CHỦ PHÒNG KHÁM • TỔNG QUAN ĐIỀU HÀNH" instead of "BS. TÂM • …".
- Next.js (U6): the native `prompt()` and `confirm()` of Hủy, Chốt tháng and Xác nhận đã chi are kit dialogs with the same questions ("Lý do hủy lượt chưa thu tiền", "Chốt số liệu tháng <tháng>? Các lượt trong kỳ sẽ bị khóa.", "Mã chứng từ chi"); the backend sentence shows inside the dialog and nothing closes until it agrees.
- Next.js (U6): "Hồ sơ" of the entry form is a search box plus a select fed by the patients API (the old one listed fixed codes P001-P999); "Gắn hóa đơn đã có" lists only the invoices of the chosen patient; the table scrolls sideways inside its frame on a phone instead of turning into cards; the page does not refresh itself every 10 s (reload with "Làm mới" and after every change).
- Next.js (U6): "Phiếu thu mới đồng bộ với app khi đang mở. Hóa đơn web cũ thu tại Thu ngân Clinic; không thu lại ở đây." is replaced by a line about the anti-duplicate key and no collection over the balance, because every invoice (procedure or quick order) is collected in this app; the notification empty line no longer names "BS. Tâm" and "app".
- App H7 "Mất kết nối" is a full error card with "Thử lại"; the web export error is one inline line and the page stays usable.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in H7: "Không xuất được bảng"

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- `<input type="number">` cannot hold the comma of "12,5": the rate boxes of the entry and rate forms use `bpToInputText` (a dot); `percentTextToBp` still accepts both.
- The line is the same `#error` element that carries every server error of the tab (WG21, WG22, WG23).
- Canvas: the old #error is drawn as the boxed danger notice under the tabs.

```tsx
  </Card>
</AppShell>
```
